ui_state.announcement:
Campaign conclusion. CAMPAIGN DEBRIEF
The Wells Belong to Those Who Carry
Official relief never arrived, but ordinary charcoal runs kept Reedwatch's boilers lit and turned the Well Commons into a durable public exchange. The caravan helped a replacement institution earn legitimacy through repeated material support rather than a restored contract.

ROUTE TIMELINE
Day 5 · Old Road → Reedwatch · 4 ashmarks · 1 provision

CARGO & CASH
Bought 6 Charcoal · -84 ashmarks
Sold 4 Charcoal · +80 ashmarks
Started with 120 ashmarks; finished with 112 (-8). Hold: empty.

TIME & PROVISIONS
Day 10 · 12 → 11 provisions (-1).

EVENT DECISIONS
No roadside event changed this campaign.

REGIONAL CONSEQUENCES
Wardens +0 · Caravans +1 · Reedwatch resilience 2/10 · arms pressure 0/6 · Well Commons support +1

CAUSAL LESSON
Official relief never arrived, but ordinary charcoal runs kept Reedwatch's boilers lit and turned the Well Commons into a durable public exchange. The caravan helped a replacement institution earn legitimacy through repeated material support rather than a restored contract.

REPLAY EXPERIMENT
Accept and complete Water Relief before Day 4, then compare public resilience with the Commons-led exchange.
Seed 1107 fixes world rolls; a different command sequence creates the comparison. Continue this region, replay the experiment, return to title, and export journey report are available.
